paper.title_en: Quantum state texture of maximal-resource Fourier states under Hawking radiation
paper.abstract_en: Quantum state texture (QST) is a recently proposed quantum resource that characterizes the nonuniformity of a density matrix in a given computational basis. In the resource theory of QST, the Fourier states f_k are maximally resourceful states, attaining the maximum QST measure. We study the QST behavior of three maximally resourceful states in a two-mode Dirac field under Hawking radiation from a Schwarzschild black hole, using a fidelity-based measure. We consider three cases: only mode B undergoes radiation, only mode A undergoes radiation, and both modes undergo radiation simultaneously. Our results show that for single-mode radiation, if the mode unaffected by radiation is orthogonal to the single-mode textureless state, the QST of the overall output state remains maximal and is independent of the Hawking temperature; we call this phenomenon orthogonality protection. When both modes undergo radiation simultaneously, orthogonality protection vanishes, and the QST of all three Fourier states decreases with increasing Hawking temperature. Notably, the QST measure of f_3 under two-mode radiation is higher than that under only mode B radiation, indicating that QST can be redistributed among modes: QST gained by one mode under radiation can partially compensate for QST lost by the other. We further provide a general resource-theoretic explanation of orthogonality protection, showing that this phenomenon is independent of the specific form of the QST measure. These results reveal how QST degrades under Hawking radiation and provide a new perspective on the redistribution of quantum resources in black hole backgrounds.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文将量子态纹理（QST）这一新提出的量子资源理论框架应用于施瓦茨席尔德黑洞霍金辐射下的双模狄拉克场，提出了正交性保护现象并给出资源论解释，理论深度较高，与黑洞热力学及霍金辐射主题高度相关，摘要表述清晰，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 霍金辐射下最大资源傅里叶态的量子态纹理
decision.abstract_zh: 量子态纹理（QST）是最近提出的一种量子资源，用于刻画密度矩阵在给定计算基下的非均匀性。在QST的资源理论中，傅里叶态f_k是最大资源态，达到QST度量的最大值。我们使用基于保真度的度量，研究施瓦茨席尔德黑洞霍金辐射下双模狄拉克场中三个最大资源态的QST行为。我们考虑三种情形：仅模B经历辐射、仅模A经历辐射，以及两个模同时经历辐射。我们的结果表明，对于单模辐射，如果未受辐射影响的模与单模无纹理态正交，则总体输出态的QST保持最大且与霍金温度无关；我们将这一现象称为正交性保护。当两个模同时经历辐射时，正交性保护消失，三个傅里叶态的QST均随霍金温度升高而减小。值得注意的是，f_3在双模辐射下的QST度量高于仅在模B辐射下的值，表明QST可以在模之间重新分配：一个模在辐射下获得的QST可以部分补偿另一个模损失的QST。我们进一步给出正交性保护的一般资源论解释，表明该现象与QST度量的具体形式无关。这些结果揭示了QST在霍金辐射下如何退化，并为黑洞背景中量子资源的重新分配提供了新视角。
